pages.title: Set up live TV
pages.description: WittyTuner's first-run step on every app, for administrators: the server's "Finish setting up WittyTuner" notice on Home opens it.

props.text: Only an administrator adds and changes tuners.

Add a TV tuner, a provider's playlist or a single stream, and its channels sit in the guide beside the ones made from your library. No channel lists or stream addresses come with the server: bring your own.

props.emptyText: Nothing answered. A device that doesn't answer a search is added by its address, in a browser.
props.title: Found on this network

props.text: A playlist's address, an IPTV provider's account and a single stream are added in Settings, Live TV & tuners, in a browser.

sources.label: Tuners

sources.title: Tuners and IPTV

sources.label: Tuners on this network
sources.description: For an administrator: the tuners that answer a search of this server's network and machine, each with a row that adds it, so no address has to be typed. It looks for a few seconds.
sources.title: Found on this network

sources.label: Guide sources
sources.description: For an administrator: each XMLTV guide source, when it was last read and how many programmes it gave, with rows to read it now or remove it.
sources.title: Guide data

sources.label: A tuner
sources.description: For an administrator: one tuner, how it is (channels, encrypted ones, a scan or check under way), then what can be done: read its channels again, scan, check every channel, turn it on or off, remove it.

params.name: tuner
params.label: Tuner
params.help: The tuner's ID, $item on its page.

sources.title: Channels

sources.label: Finishing the first-run step
sources.description: For an administrator: rows to finish WittyTuner's first-run step or put it off, which tell the server to stop showing "Finish setting up WittyTuner". Nothing for anyone else.

commands.label: Add it
commands.description: Live TV, administrators: adds a tuner the search found on this network (item: what the search called it), and reads its channels.

commands.label: Read its channels again
commands.description: Live TV, administrators: reads a tuner's channel list again (item: its ID). What was chosen for each channel stays.

commands.label: Scan for channels
commands.description: Live TV, administrators: has a tuner look for channels (item: its ID), which can take minutes; its page says how far it has got.

commands.label: Check every channel
commands.description: Live TV, administrators: tunes each of a tuner's channels in turn (item: its ID), a few at a time, and keeps which ones work.

commands.label: Stop checking
commands.description: Live TV, administrators: stops a tuner's channel check (item: its ID).

commands.label: Turn it on
commands.description: Live TV, administrators: a tuner's channels are in the guide again (item: its ID).

commands.label: Turn it off
commands.description: Live TV, administrators: a tuner's channels leave the guide, and nothing is recorded from it (item: its ID).

commands.label: Remove
commands.description: Live TV, administrators: removes a tuner, its channels and its own guide source (item: its ID).

commands.label: Show in the guide
commands.description: Live TV, administrators: a channel is in the guide (item: its ID).

commands.label: Hide from the guide
commands.description: Live TV, administrators: a channel leaves the guide (item: its ID).

commands.label: Read it now
commands.description: Live TV, administrators: reads a guide source again now, in the background (item: its ID).

commands.label: Remove
commands.description: Live TV, administrators: removes a guide source (item: its ID), and what the guide kept from it.

commands.label: Finish setting up
commands.description: Administrators: WittyTuner's first-run step is done, so the server stops showing "Finish setting up WittyTuner".

commands.label: Do this later
commands.description: Administrators: WittyTuner's first-run step is put off; everything in it is in Settings, Live TV & tuners.
